crossRefs.note: He took up his parable, and said, “From Aram has Balak brought me, the king of Moab from the mountains of the East.…

people.name: Mesha
people.line: A place marking the Joktanite territory

people.name: Sephar
people.line: Boundary of the territory settled by Joktan's descendants

translations.web: Their dwelling extended from Mesha, as you go toward Sephar, the mountain of the east.
translations.bsb: Their territory extended from Mesha to Sephar, in the eastern hill country.
translations.kjv: And their dwelling was from Mesha, as thou goest unto Sephar a mount of the east.
translations.asv: And their dwelling was from Mesha, as thou goest toward Sephar, the mountain of the east.
